Bahog-
Bahog

Leave base late and you hunt. Leave early and you’re hunted.

  • #Everyone who steps out gets a number. Lower number left earlier.
  • ▲Red triangle: that player left after you and can tag you. Run home to reset your number.
  • ●Green circle: they left before you. Touch them to send them to jail.
  • ★Stand in the enemy’s chalk circle for half a second to score.
  • ✦Stand alone in the plaza for 3 seconds (an enemy stepping in cancels it) to channel a random imba drop.
  • ⇧Street terrain: Shift to jump barikadas and kanals, walk into the crate wall to climb, and you crawl through the lagusan automatically.
  • ⚑Pick a class below. Bots fill every other slot on both teams, so you can play alone.

About the street game

Bahog-Bahog is played on Filipino streets with two bases drawn in chalk. Whoever leaves base later can tag anyone who left earlier, so stepping out is both how you attack and how you get caught. Tagged players wait in jail until a teammate touches them free. This version adds a plaza in the middle that drops powerful items to whoever holds it.

3D models: Kenney City, Racing and Platformer kits (MIT) and RobotExpressive by Tomás Laulhé (CC0).
